verdict.rationale: Mastra documents human-in-the-loop workflows that can suspend and wait for user approval before resuming, which covers the approval-prompt part of the story. It is framed as a workflow feature, not a per-action gate on dangerous tool or command execution. Missing for 10: command allowlists, opt-in elevated modes per action, per-tool approval gating for dangerous actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action

citations.quote: Mastra workflows also support human-in-the-loop functionality, allowing developers to suspend a workflow and await user input or approval before resuming.
